name: travel-crm-root
description: TravelCRM Pro — Multi-tenant Tours & Travels SaaS CRM

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n api,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev -w travelcrm-desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @travelcrm/shared && npm run build -w travelcrm-desktop
scripts.deploy: npm run infra && npm run secrets:push && npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:desktop && npm run deploy:admin
scripts.deploy:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npx wrangler pages deploy desktop/.next --project-name travelcrm-desktop
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && npx wrangler pages deploy super-admin/.vercel/output/static --project-name travelcrm-admin
scripts.infra: cd terraform && terraform init -input=false && terraform apply -auto-approve && cd .. && npm run infra:sync
scripts.infra:plan: cd terraform && terraform init -input=false && terraform plan
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck -w travelcrm-desktop
scripts.analyze: cd packages/shared && dart analyze && cd ../driver_app && dart analyze
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:flutter
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../super-admin && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install && melos bootstrap && npm run dev:codegen && npm run infra:sync
scripts.clean: melos run clean && cd backend && rm -rf node_modules && cd ../super-admin && rm -rf node_modules .next && cd ../desktop && rm -rf node_modules .next
